description:
Add a widget at the end of an SEO Reporting report. WRITE action — requires the write scope. type: performance_chart (evolution chart; pick its metric: clicks, impressions, ctr or position), clicks_graph, impressions_graph, top_performance (scorecard), keywords or urls (tables). Scope the widget to a Smart View (viewId, from list_smart_views) OR to tags (tags + tagType page|keyword, names from list_tags) — not both; omit both for an unfiltered widget. Period: periodDays (rolling window ending on the property's last data date, default 28) OR from/to (Y-m-d) — not both; the previous period for comparison is set automatically. The widget appears in the SEOcrawl UI like one added by hand. To repeat the same chart for many views use duplicate_report_widget. Errors: reporting_not_available, not_found (report), invalid_widget_type, invalid_metric, metric_not_supported (metric only applies to performance_chart), invalid_date_range, conflicting_filter, smart_view_not_found, tag_not_found, tag_type_mismatch, widget_limit_reached (50 widgets per report). Get the reportId from list_reports / create_report. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// add a 28-day clicks evolution chart filtered by a Smart View.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","reportId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","type":"performance_chart","metric":"clicks","periodDays":28,"viewId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"}
```

metric.description: Metric of a performance_chart (default clicks). Not valid for other types.

periodDays.description: Rolling window in days ending on the last data date. Default 28.

tagType.description: Whether tags are page or keyword tags. Default page.

tags.description: Tag names to filter by (from list_tags). Alternative to viewId.

name: add_report_widget

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

data.description: Stored widget config: period, startDate/endDate (d-m-Y), typeMetric, previous-period dates.

filter.description: The applied filter (Smart View or tag selection), or null when the widget is unfiltered.

title: Add report widget
